```{r}
library(readr)
pickleballData <- read_csv("pickleballData.csv")

pick <- pickleBall |>
  mutate(Overall_Rating_Reliability = ifelse(
    `Overall Reliability` >= 0.6, 1, 0
  )) |>
  group_by(Sex) |>
  summarise(
    count_good_reliability = sum(Overall_Rating_Reliability, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) 
View(pick)
```
